New adapter html_listing. Request: GET https://western.sare.org/grants/ (plain HTTP, no cookies, UA as engine). Parse: for each
  • block take h3 text as title (prefix "SARE Western: "), first

    as description, href as url (external_id = last URL path segment), and

    text split at first colon into status (lowercased: closed|open|opens) and deadline text ("Mon D, YYYY H:MM AM/PM (TZ)", parsed to a timestamp in America/Denver). Emit one opportunity per listing; if the h4 text is missing, deadline null. Fail the run if zero listings parse (guard against layout change). Keep a row per program: the programs recur annually so status changes in place. Config: {url, list_selector:"li.listing", title_selector:"h3", desc_selector:"p", link_selector:"a.learn", deadline_selector:"h4.grant-deadline"}.
